phases.discovery: Portal reads role assignments from powerpagecomponent content JSON 'adx_entitypermission_webrole' array, NOT from mspp_entitypermission_webrole intersection table
phases.evidence: Working permission (dcfg_contract) has adx_entitypermission_webrole in content JSON. Failing permission (dcfg_permtest) did not.

results.notes: Test record 'E2E Test Record' returned successfully

keyLearnings: mspp_entitypermissions POST creates the record but does NOT set role links in the portal-readable format
$ref N:N links create intersection table records but portal ignores them
Portal reads adx_entitypermission_webrole from powerpagecomponent (type=18) content JSON
Update-Record helper works for PATCH on mspp_ tables where raw Invoke-RestMethod fails
N:N navigation property mspp_entitypermission_webrole always returns 0 — platform bug
Intersection entityset name is mspp_entitypermission_webroleset (non-standard pluralization)
Site setting content format is {"value":"true"} not just 'true'
Table creation via metadata API requires IsPrimaryName=$true in Attributes array
E2E validation requires Playwright with manual Windows Hello auth

winningApproach.summary: New-Record to mspp_entitypermissions → PATCH powerpagecomponent content JSON with adx_entitypermission_webrole → create site settings → clear cache → verify via /_api/
